$comment: The City's neon signs: file extension -> the PROJECT language it votes for. ONE table, read by both sides: Rust (src-tauri/src/external_agents/language.rs, include_str!) tallies external agents' transcripts with it, the Village (villageModel.ts) tallies the IDE's Agent Logs lines with it. Only programming languages vote: markup, styles, config, data and docs never do (a Rust project's agent edits Markdown and TOML all day). Every row must agree with the editor's own detection (src/lib/language) once its families are folded (tsx -> typescript, jsx -> javascript, objective-cpp -> objective-c) - pinned by villageModel.test.tsx - and every language here has a neon style (render/neon.ts, pinned by neon.test.ts). Keys are lowercase extensions without the dot.
